raw_segments.text: So I snuffed the candle and resumed the perusal of Marmion.
My eye was instantly drawn to his movements.
He only took out a Morocco pocketbook, thence produced a letter, which he read in silence,
folded it, put it back, relapsed into meditation.
It was vain to try to read with such an inscrutable fixture before me, nor could I in impatience
He might rebuff me if he liked, but talk I would.
